powers: On your turn, you may recharge a spell to examine the top 2 cards of your location deck. If any examined card has the Undead trait, (☐ you may ignore any power on that card that happens when examined and) you may encounter 1 of them.
You may discard (☐ or recharge) a spell or a blessing to reduce damage dealt to you by 3 (☐ 5).
Add 1d8 to your check against a card that has the Undead trait.
